mapper.select: select sum(VALUE_INCREMENT) from BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA where SUBJECT_NO in ( select DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO from BOK_BUSS_DETSUB where (FSUBJECT_ID like '1102%' or FSUBJECT_ID like '1103%' or FSUBJECT_ID like '1104%') and DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO_TAIL=#{busiId} ) and val_date = #{booksetdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetID}
SELECT prod_id FROM REP_PROD_INFO where f_prod_id=#{fprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select A.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId,--业务明细代码 A.POS_AMT posAmt,--当前持仓 A.TDY_INTINCEXP_B tdyIntincexp,--当日累计应计利息余额 A.MDATE mdate,--到期日 A.TDY_POSITION tdyPosition,--当日计提份额 A.TDY_Cost_Amt tdyCostAmt,--当日成本 A.END_DAYS_COST_AMT endDaysCostAmt,--剩余期限用成本 A.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_B tdyFloatIngpl,--当日累计公允价值变动_本位币 A.END_DAYS_1 endDays1,--剩余期限 A.END_DAYS_2 endDays2,--剩余存续期限 A.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType,--金融产品类型 A.BUSI_ID busiId --业务明细代码 from BOK_STAT_DET_POSIITON A WHERE 1=1 AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} and HAPPEN_DATE = #{happenDate} and BOOK_DATE= #{bookDate} /***选取上游数据时不取资金账户信息 leipeng 20200414***/ and FINPROD_TYPE != 'F20' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT F WHERE F.FINPROD_ID=A.BUSI_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F29','F30') ) union all select p.FINPROD_ID bokDetailId,--金融产品代码 P.SHARE_AMT posAmt,--数量 P.TDY_INTINCEXP_B tdyIntincexp,--当日应计利息本位币 decode(f.MDATE,null,t.MDATE,f.MDATE) mdate,--到期日 decode(f.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F10',p.SHARE_AMT,0) tdyPosition,--当日份额 decode(f.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F10',p.DSC_COST_AMT,0) tdyCostAmt,--当日成本 decode(f.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F10',p.DSC_COST_AMT,0) endDaysCostAmt,--剩余期限成本 p.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_B tdyFloatIngpl,--公允价值变动本位币 p.END_DAYS_1 endDays1,--剩余期限 P.END_DAYS_2 endDays2,--剩余存续期 decode(f.FINPROD_TYPE2,null,t.FINPROD_TYPE2,f.FINPROD_TYPE2) finprodType, --金融产品类型 P.FINPROD_ID busiId from PTL_SEC_VALUTION p left join ( select BB.BOOKSET_ID, case when BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE='F18' then bb.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID else fp.PORTFOLIO_ID end as PORTFOLIO_ID from BOK_BOOKSET BB left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp on BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID ) D on p.PORTFOLIO_ID=D.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT f on p.FINPROD_ID=f.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT t on t.FINPROD_ID=p.FINPROD_ID where (f.FINPROD_TYPE2='F10' or t.FINPROD_TYPE2 in('F11','F12','F13','F14','F29','F30')) and D.BOOKSET_ID=#{booksetId} and p.CDATE=#{bookDate}
